title: Step 61-H integrated Product Detail acceptance and browser prototype
description: Accept the production Product Detail flow as one integrated Storefront surface using deterministic mock-backed SSR and browser interaction. Verify product identity, variant selection, authoritative Toman price/stock, media controls, specifications, related content, add-to-cart, SEO, empty/error recovery states, RTL/mobile/accessibility and existing capability boundaries. No new product feature, backend, OpenAPI, database, dependency, workflow, final Roadmap/Current-State closure, or Step 62+ behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Integrated mock-backed Product Detail SSR verifies ready product, variant price/stock, media/specification/related surfaces, canonical metadata, and backend-owned GET authority.
Browser acceptance exercises variant selection, media controls and add-to-cart on the production Product Detail route and preserves existing responsive/axe/keyboard Storefront Quality gates.
Not-found Product Detail resolves to an explicit no-result state with no invented canonical metadata; unsupported 3D/360 remains explicitly unavailable.
No runtime feature, backend/OpenAPI/database/dependency/workflow or Step 62+ behavior is introduced by Stage H.

Canonical completion requires exact-head provider checks, deterministic Review, artifact-bound ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before Stage 61-I.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Provider risk classification is authoritative; HIGH escalation requires Security and Owner Human Gate.
